preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == len(grid[0]) for row in grid)
preconditions.description: All rows in the grid have the same length (m), and the grid is non-empty.

preconditions.expression: all(cell in {'X', 'O'} for row in grid for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the grid is either 'X' or 'O'.

postconditions.expression: return_value == len({tuple(sorted((i, j) for i in range(len(grid)) for j in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[i][j] == 'X' and not visited[i][j])) for visited in [{[False]*len(grid[0]) for _ in range(len(grid))}]})
postconditions.description: The return value equals the number of connected 'X' groups, where a group is defined as a set of 'X's connected horizontally or vertically (no diagonals). Each group is uniquely identified by its cells, and the count is computed via a traversal (e.g., DFS/BFS) marking visited cells.
